'''Lorana's lightsaber''' was the personal [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Lorana Jinzler]]. It was [[Color/Legends|green-bladed]], with a [[Metal/Legends|metal]] [[Hilt/Legends|hilt]] and an [[Amethyst/Legends|amethyst]] attached to its [[Activation stud|activation switch]]. Lorana used the lightsaber during [[Gender/Legends|her]] time as the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]] and later when she embarked for unknown [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxies]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] aboard ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', a massive [[Starship/Legends|starship]] made up of several [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]]. She wielded it throughout the [[Outbound Flight Project]] up until she [[Death/Legends|died]] saving the lives of the surviving passengers of ''Outbound Flight''.

The weapon was re-discovered over fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later aboard ''[[Dreadnaught-One]]'' near her remains by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] during an [[Expedition to Outbound Flight|expedition]] with the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] to investigate the wreckage of ''Outbound Flight''. Skywalker took the lightsaber and eventually showed it to Lorana's younger brother [[Dean Jinzler]]. Jinzler, who had joined the mission by posing as a diplomat for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], identified it as Lorana's and Skywalker offered the weapon to him. Though Jinzler accepted the offering, he postponed taking it, believing the Jedi might need it during their attempt to prevent the escape of a group of [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] warriors aboard ''[[Dreadnaught-Four]]'' who sought to [[Thief/Legends|steal]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to attack the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. During the ensuing [[Battle of the Redoubt|battle]], Jade Skywalker used Lorana's lightsaber to defeat a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]], and the weapon was destroyed in the resulting explosion. Although no part of Lorana's lightsaber survived to present to Jinzler, because his journey to the wreckage of ''Outbound Flight'' allowed him to come to terms with his difficult relationship with his sister, he was able to accept the loss and felt it was fitting that the weapon be sacrificed to protect the expedition's remaining survivors.

==Description==
[[File:Lorana_Jinzler_OFJP.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Lorana Jinzler]]
Constructed at some point prior to [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Mission to Barlok|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]<ref name="TERC" /> [[Lorana Jinzler]]'s [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] was a well-made weapon that was built to last. Consequently, when it was discovered along with her remains aboard ''[[Outbound Flight]]'' over five [[Standard decade/Legends|decades later]], the still produced a functional blade, although the characteristic "''snap-hiss''" sound made upon activation was weak.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> The lightsaber's hilt was a short, silver [[Color/Legends|colored]] cylinder made out of metal with an [[Amethyst/Legends|amethyst]] gemstone attached to the [[activation stud]]. The amethyst was a gift from a group of [[Coruscanti/Legends|citizens]] from the mid-levels of the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who were once rescued by Lorana and [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]]; unbeknownst to Lorana, it was given on behalf of her [[Dean and Lorana Jinzler's mother|mother]] and [[Dean and Lorana Jinzler's father|father]]. When activated, Lorana's lightsaber produced a green blade.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==History==
Lorana's lightsaber was constructed during her [[Time/Legends|time]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. She used it while on a mission to Barlok when she was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] apprenticed to Jorus C'baoth and as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] she brought it along when she embarked for [[Extragalactic/Legends|other]] [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxies]] aboard ''[[Outbound Flight]]'', a massive [[Starship/Legends|starship]] consisting of six connected [[Dreadnaught-class heavy cruiser/Legends|''Dreadnaught''-class heavy cruisers]]. Lorana wielded it throughout the [[Outbound Flight Project]] expedition up until her [[Death/Legends|death]] aboard ''[[Dreadnaught-One]]'', when she sacrificed herself alongside the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Syndic/Legends|Syndic]] [[Mitth'ras'safis/Legends|Mitth'ras'safis]] to save the surviving passengers of ''[[Dreadnaught-Four]]''.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

[[File:LukeMaraDroideka-TERC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Luke and Mara Jade Skywalker used Lorana's lightsaber to destroy a droideka on ''Dreadnaught-Four''.]]
Over fifty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="TERC" /> the Jedi Master Luke Skywalker and his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] Jedi Knight Mara Jade Skywalker rediscovered both Lorana's body and her lightsaber and Skywalker took possession of the lightsaber. Eventually, he showed it to Lorana's younger brother [[Dean Jinzler]] in the aftermath of an attack on ''Outbound Flight'' by warriors of the [[Vagaari Empire]]. While Skywalker suspected the lightsaber might have belonged to C'baoth, Jinzler, who joined the mission by posing as a diplomat for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] identified it as Lorana's. Skywalker offered to give the weapon to him and although Jinzler accepted the offering, he postponed taking it. Instead, he told Skywalker to temporarily keep it, believing the Jedi would need it in their attempt to prevent the escape of a group of [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] warriors aboard ''[[Dreadnaught-Four]]'' who had [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for use against the enemy [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. During the ensuing [[Battle of the Redoubt|battle]], Jade Skywalker used Lorana's lightsaber to destroy a [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]]. After maneuvering the droideka above the lightsaber, she used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to activate the blade from a safe distance and destroy its mini-reactor. In hitting the mini-reactor, Jade Skywalker triggered a large explosion that destroyed both the droideka and lightsaber. Although the two Jedi searched, they could not find any remaining part of Lorana's lightsaber to present to her brother. Despite the loss of the last remaining material connection to his sister, his journey to the place where Lorana sacrificed her life helped Jinzler come to terms with the bitter feelings he once had for his sister. As a result, he was able to accept the loss and felt it was fitting that the weapon was sacrificed to protect the survivors of ''Outbound Flight'', just as Lorana had given her own life.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lorana's lightsaber first appeared in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> It was first pictured in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']], in the cover art of the second volume of the novel's Japanese edition.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
